title: China's Xi keeps Iranian president at arm's length weeks ahead of Trump summit
summary_full: China's Xi gave Iran's Pezeshkian a brief, low-profile audience at the SCO summit, as Beijing seeks to avoid appearing close to Tehran ahead of a high-stakes summit with Trump.
